body.p: Claims 1-17 and 20 are pending in the present application. Claim 1 is amended in this paper. No claims are canceled in this paper. No new claims are added in this paper.

necessarily conceding in this application that these claims, as originally presented, are not patentable over the references cited by the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office (USPTO), as pertinent ones of the present claim amendments and cancellations are only for facilitating expeditious prosecution. body.p: Concurrently with this response, Applicant has filed a Request for Continued
Examination with the appropriate fee. Applicant respectfully request that prosecution be reopened and all prior rejections be withdrawn.
Childress/Struzik/Glaser/Paget
Claims 1, 6, 15 and 17 stand rejected under 35 U.S.C. § 103 as allegedly unpatentable

over U.S. Patent Appl. Publ. No. 20090090724 Al to Childress et al. (hereinafter "Childress"); in view of U.S. Patent Appl. Publ. No. 20130197791 Al to Struzik et al. (hereinafter "Struzik"); further in view of U.S. Patent Appl. Publ. No. 20110042520 Al to Glaser; Daniel et al. (hereinafter "Glaser"), and further in view of U.S. Patent Appl. Publ. No 20230294836 Al to Paget, Darren et al. (hereinafter "Paget"). Office Action, p. 3. Applicant respectfully traverses the rejection.
Claim 1 as amended recites:
A method for fueling and using an aircraft, wherein the method comprises:
conditioning a fuel tank, wherein the fuel tank comprises a chamber between an inner
wall and an outer wall of the fuel tank, wherein the chamber includes at least one layer of reflective foil within an insulative material, and wherein clean dry gas is pumped into the
chamber to aid in insulating a liquid gas fuel;
storing, liquified gas fuel using the fuel tank comprising the chamber between the inner
wall and the outer wall of the fuel tank, wherein the chamber is configured to insulate the
liquid gas fuel by prevention of condensation of humidity within the fuel tank of the
aircraft;
fueling, using a fuel line, the aircraft, wherein fueling further comprises:
filling the fuel tank with the liquified gas fuel to a desired level, wherein the desired level
comprises fuel for a plurality of flights plus reserves, wherein a sensor connected to the
fuel tank detects at least abnormal phenomena related insulation of the fuel tank, wherein
the sensor is configured to:
detect humidity within the fuel tank; and
convert the detected at least abnormal phenomena into a signal that is then transmitted to
a computing device; and
removing, using the computing device, the fuel line as function of the desired level in the
aircraft; and
preparing the fuel tank for flight as a function of the desired level; and flying, using the aircraft, a plurality of flights using the liquid gas fuel.

The Office has not asserted that Childress teaches, suggests, or motivates "conditioning a fuel tank, wherein the fuel tank comprises a chamber between an inner wall and an outer wall of the fuel tank, wherein the chamber includes at least one layer of reflective foil within an insulative material" as recited by amended claim 1. Accordingly, Applicant respectfully submits that Childress does not teach, suggest, or motivate "conditioning a fuel tank, wherein the fuel tank comprises a chamber between an inner wall and an outer wall of the fuel tank, wherein the outer wall includes multiple layers of reflective foil within an insulative material." Applicant respectfully submits that Childress fails to teach, suggest, or motivate Applicant's particularly claimed method and limitations, for at least the reasons discussed above.

Struzik does not cure the deficiency of Childress. The Office has not asserted that Struzik teaches, suggests, or motivates "conditioning a fuel tank, wherein the fuel tank comprises a chamber between an inner wall and an outer wall of the fuel tank, wherein the outer wall includes multiple layers of reflective foil within an insulative material" as recited by amended claim 1. Accordingly, Applicant respectfully submits that Struzik does not teach, suggest, or motivate "conditioning a fuel tank, wherein the fuel tank comprises a chamber between an inner wall and an outer wall of the fuel tank, wherein the outer wall includes multiple layers of reflective foil within an insulative material." Therefore, Applicant respectfully submits that Childress and Struzki, alone or in combination, fail to teach, suggest, or motivate Applicant's particularly claimed method and limitations for at least the reasons discussed above.

Glaser does not cure the deficiency of Childress and Struzik. The Office has not asserted that Glaser teaches, suggests, or motivates "conditioning a fuel tank, wherein the fuel tank comprises a chamber between an inner wall and an outer wall of the fuel tank, wherein the outer wall includes multiple layers of reflective foil within an insulative material" as recited by amended claim 1. Accordingly, Applicant respectfully submits that Glaser does not teach, suggest, or motivate "conditioning a fuel tank, wherein the fuel tank comprises a chamber between an inner wall and an outer wall of the fuel tank, wherein the outer wall includes multiple layers of reflective foil within an insulative material." Therefore, Applicant respectfully submits that Childress, Struzki, and Glaser, alone or in combination, fail to teach, suggest, or motivate Applicant's particularly claimed method and limitations for at least the reasons discussed above.

Paget does not cure the deficiency of Childress, Struzki and Glaser. The Office has not asserted that Paget teaches, suggests, or motivates "conditioning a fuel tank, wherein the fuel tank comprises a chamber between an inner wall and an outer wall of the fuel tank, wherein the outer wall includes multiple layers of reflective foil within an insulative material" recited by claim 1 as amended. Accordingly, Applicant respectfully submits that Paget does not teach, suggest, or motivate "conditioning a fuel tank, wherein the fuel tank comprises a chamber between an inner wall and an outer wall of the fuel tank, wherein the outer wall includes multiple layers of reflective foil within an insulative material." As such, Applicant respectfully submits that Childress, Struzki, Glaser, and Paget, alone or in combination, fail to teach, suggest, or motivate Applicant's particularly claimed method and limitations and claim 1 as amended is patentably distinguishable over Childress, Struzki, Glaser, and Paget, alone or in combination, for at least the reasons discussed above. Therefore, Applicant respectfully requests the withdrawal of this rejection.
Each of claims 6, 15 and 17 depends, directly or indirectly, from claim 1. As noted

above, claim 1 is patentably distinguishable over Childress, Struzik, Glaser, and Paget, alone or in combination, for at least the reasons discussed above. Accordingly, Applicant respectfully submits that claims 6, 15 and 17 are patentably distinguishable over Childress, Struzik, Glaser, and Paget, alone or in combination, for at least the reasons discussed above. Therefore, Applicant respectfully requests the withdrawal of these rejections.
